name: LongVideoBench
intro: LongVideoBench是一个以长达一小时的视频-语言交错输入为特色的问答基准。它包含3763个不同长度的网络视频及其字幕，旨在全面评估大型多模态模型（LMM）的长期多模态理解能力。该基准测试引入了一种新的视频问答任务，称为“引用推理”，要求模型根据问题中引用的视频上下文来推理相关的视频细节。LongVideoBench包含6678个人工标注的多项选择题，涵盖17个细分领域，为长视频理解提供了一个全面的评估框架。
build_method: 网络爬取, 人工标注
intro_en: LongVideoBench is a QA benchmark featuring video-language inputs up to one hour long. It includes 3,763 web videos of varying lengths with subtitles, designed to comprehensively evaluate the long-term multimodal understanding ability of large multimodal models (LMMs). The benchmark introduces a new video QA task called "reference reasoning," which requires models to infer relevant video details based on referenced video context in the questions. LongVideoBench contains 6,678 human-annotated multiple-choice questions across 17 subdomains, providing a comprehensive evaluation framework for long video understanding.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect 720P+ web videos from 119 channels across 10 content categories and four duration groups"] --> B["Filter for English subtitles and transcribe missing subtitles with Whisper-V3-Large"]
    B --> C["Sample topics uniformly and score visual quality with Q-Align"]
    C --> D["Manually filter candidates to retain 3,763 final videos"]
    D --> E["Design referring queries that pinpoint relevant video moments as referred context"]
    E --> F["Annotate perception and relation questions across 17 fine-grained categories"]
    F --> G["Collect 6,678 human-annotated multiple-choice question-answer pairs"]
    G --> H["Evaluate long-video multimodal models with accuracy across duration and question categories"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从119个频道收集720P以上网页视频，覆盖10类内容和4个时长组"] --> B["筛选英文字幕视频，并用Whisper-V3-Large转录缺失字幕"]
    B --> C["按主题均匀采样并用Q-Align评估视觉质量"]
    C --> D["人工过滤候选视频，保留3763个最终视频"]
    D --> E["设计引用查询，定位相关视频片段作为引用上下文"]
    E --> F["按感知和关系两级标注17个细分类别问题"]
    F --> G["收集6678个人工标注的多选问答对"]
    G --> H["按时长组和问题类别用准确率评估长视频多模态模型"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2407.15754. The paper reports 3,763 web-collected videos from 119 channels across 10 content categories and four duration groups, subtitle filtering with Whisper-V3-Large where needed, Q-Align and manual filtering, and 6,678 human-annotated multiple-choice referring-reasoning questions in 17 fine-grained categories evaluated by accuracy.
